name: ZTL-543 Brush Cutter
summary: The ZTL-543 is a shoulder-carried, petrol-powered brush cutter built around an air-cooled two-stroke engine.
description: The ZTL-543 is a shoulder-carried, petrol-powered brush cutter built around an air-cooled two-stroke engine. Its bull-horn (bike-style) handlebar, aluminium drive shaft and gear head make it suited to clearing weeds, tall grass, bush and overgrown verges on farms, plantations, roadsides and compounds. It ships with a metal cutting blade and blade guard and a padded shoulder harness.
features: Two-stroke petrol engine with recoil (pull) start
Bull-horn handlebar with throttle trigger and safety lock-out
Aluminium alloy drive tube with right-angle gear head
Steel brush blade with protective guard; can take a nylon trimmer head
Padded carrying harness for long working sessions

specs.label: Cutting tools
specs.value: Metal blade (supplied); nylon line head optional

typicalUses: Weeding, bush clearing, plantation and orchard maintenance, roadside and compound grass cutting.

name: Multi-Purpose Chaff Cutter
summary: A combined chaff cutter and grain crusher for livestock farmers.
description: A combined chaff cutter and grain crusher for livestock farmers. Green forage, grass, maize stalks and straw are fed on the side conveyor and chopped into short lengths, while dry grain and tubers loaded into the top hopper are crushed and discharged through a separate outlet. Driven by an electric motor through V-belts and mounted on wheels for moving around the farm.
features: Side feed conveyor for grass, straw and stalks (automatic feeding)
Top hopper for grains, sweet potato and other tubers
Separate outlets for chopped forage and crushed grain
Belt-driven electric motor on a wheeled steel frame
Hinged covers for blade and screen access

specs.label: Power source
specs.value: Electric motor (single- or three-phase; typically 2.2–3 kW on this frame size)

specs.label: Typical capacity
specs.value: Approx. 500–1,500 kg/h forage, depending on material and motor

typicalUses: Preparing chopped forage and crushed grain for cattle, sheep, goats, rabbits and poultry.

name: Model 900 Multi-Functional Thresher
summary: A large-drum multi-crop thresher designed to separate grain from harvested stalks and pods, with a built-in fan and vibrating screens that clean the grain as it threshes.
description: A large-drum multi-crop thresher designed to separate grain from harvested stalks and pods, with a built-in fan and vibrating screens that clean the grain as it threshes. The Model 900 is supplied with a mobile tyre rack on 400-12 tyres so it can be towed between fields, and is belt-driven by a diesel engine, electric motor or tractor PTO.
features: Long threshing drum with spike/rasp-bar beaters
Integrated fan and screens for cleaning
Belt drive – works with diesel engine, electric motor or tractor

specs.label: Crops
specs.value: Typically maize, sorghum, millet, soybean, beans, rice and wheat (with matching screens) – confirm

specs.label: Power required
specs.value: Typically 15–25 hp diesel engine or equivalent motor

typicalUses: Farm and community threshing of cereals and legumes; contract threshing services.

name: Grain Grinding Mill (Pulverizer with Cyclone)
summary: A belt-driven grain grinding mill fitted with a feed hopper, grinding chamber and cyclone collector.
description: A belt-driven grain grinding mill fitted with a feed hopper, grinding chamber and cyclone collector. The fan draws ground flour from the chamber up through the pipe into the cyclone, which drops the product cleanly into a bag and cuts down on dust. It is widely used for maize, millet, sorghum, rice, soybean, dry pepper and spices.
features: Cast-iron grinding chamber with interchangeable screen
Cyclone dust collector for cleaner bagging
Pulley drive – electric motor or diesel/petrol engine

specs.label: Type
specs.value: Pulverizer / grinding mill – disc or hammer configuration to confirm

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Typically 5.5–11 kW motor or 8–15 hp engine

specs.label: Typical capacity
specs.value: Approx. 100–500 kg/h depending on grain and screen

typicalUses: Maize flour, millet and sorghum flour, livestock feed meal, spice powders.

name: SOLO PORT 423 Motorized Mist Blower
summary: A backpack petrol mist blower for applying pesticides, fungicides and foliar fertiliser.
description: A backpack petrol mist blower for applying pesticides, fungicides and foliar fertiliser. A high-speed air stream breaks the liquid into fine droplets and carries it deep into dense crop canopies such as cocoa, coffee, citrus and vegetables. The genuine SOLO PORT 423 is made in Germany and is one of the most widely used mist blowers in West African cocoa spraying.
features: 14-litre UV-protected liquid tank with stainless-steel filter
Single-hand control for throttle, spray volume and stop
Anti-vibration system and padded harness with hip belt
Supplied with misting nozzle (4 settings) and accessory nozzles/grilles

specs.label: Application
specs.value: Mist spraying; optional ULV and dusting kits

typicalUses: Cocoa, coffee and plantation spraying, vegetable and orchard pest control, public-health fogging.

name: JLX Rice Destoner
summary: A rice destoner removes stones, sand and other heavy impurities from paddy or milled rice before packing.
description: A rice destoner removes stones, sand and other heavy impurities from paddy or milled rice before packing. Grain flows over an inclined, vibrating screen deck while air is blown up through it; lighter grain floats off and travels to the outlet, while heavier stones walk up the deck and are discharged separately. Removing stones protects downstream machines and improves the quality and price of the rice.
features: Inclined vibrating screen deck with adjustable angle
Fan for air separation of grain and stones
Separate outlets for clean rice and stones
Compact enough for small and medium rice mills

specs.label: Applicable grains
specs.value: Paddy, milled rice; also wheat, beans and other grains

typicalUses: Cleaning rice in milling lines and at packaging centres.

name: Belt-Driven Centrifugal Water Pump
summary: A cast-iron, end-suction centrifugal pump driven by a V-belt pulley, so it can be powered by a diesel engine, electric motor or tractor.
description: A cast-iron, end-suction centrifugal pump driven by a V-belt pulley, so it can be powered by a diesel engine, electric motor or tractor. It is fitted with a hand-operated priming pump to fill the casing before starting, and is designed for moving large volumes of water at low-to-medium head for irrigation, drainage and water transfer.
features: Heavy cast-iron volute casing and impeller
Base mounting for skid or trolley

specs.label: Typical flow
specs.value: Approx. 30–200 m³/h depending on size and speed

specs.label: Drive
specs.value: Diesel engine, electric motor or tractor via belt

typicalUses: Field irrigation from rivers, dams and canals; fish ponds; drainage and dewatering.

name: Groundnut Sheller
summary: A motorised machine that removes the shells from dried groundnuts with minimal breakage.
description: A motorised machine that removes the shells from dried groundnuts with minimal breakage. Pods are loaded into the large top hopper, cracked between a rotor and adjustable grate, and a fan blows the light shells away through the side duct while clean kernels fall from the outlet. It replaces hours of hand shelling and is mounted on wheels.
features: Rotor with interchangeable screens for different nut sizes
Fan and cyclone duct for shell separation
Wheeled frame; electric motor or engine drive

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Typically 3–7.5 kW motor or 8–15 hp engine

typicalUses: Shelling groundnuts for seed, oil, paste and sale.

name: PLUS.HONDAY GX200 Gasoline Engine
summary: A general-purpose 4-stroke, single-cylinder petrol engine in the popular GX200 / 168F class (about 6.5 hp).
description: A general-purpose 4-stroke, single-cylinder petrol engine in the popular GX200 / 168F class (about 6.5 hp). It has a horizontal output shaft with a twin-groove pulley, recoil start and a large fuel tank, and is used to drive water pumps, mills, threshers, generators and other small farm machines. PLUS.HONDAY is a separate brand and is not a Honda engine.
features: Horizontal keyed shaft with V-belt pulley
Oil alert and fuel-tap on most units
Fits machines designed for GX200-class engines
typicalUses: Powering water pumps, grinding mills, rice hullers, threshers and sprayers.

name: Wet & Dry Mini Grinding Mill
summary: A compact, petrol-engine-powered grinding mill on a steel stand, popular for village and market grinding services.
description: A compact, petrol-engine-powered grinding mill on a steel stand, popular for village and market grinding services. The cast grinding head with an adjustable hand-wheel sets the fineness, and the large funnel hopper feeds maize, beans, groundnuts, pepper, tomatoes and other foods. Wet-type grinding plates allow soaked maize and vegetables to be ground into paste.
features: Petrol engine with belt drive and guard
Hand-wheel adjustment for coarse to fine grinding
Portable steel frame – no mains power needed

specs.label: Products
specs.value: Maize, millet, beans, groundnut, pepper, tomato, ginger (wet capability to confirm)

typicalUses: Corn-mill kiosks, households, restaurants and food vendors.

name: CHP150 Rice Milling Machine
summary: A stationary vertical rice mill (whitener) that removes the bran layer from brown rice to produce white rice.
description: A stationary vertical rice mill (whitener) that removes the bran layer from brown rice to produce white rice. Grain is fed from the large upper hopper into the milling chamber; the outlet pressure is adjusted with the weighted lever and handwheel to control whiteness, while bran is discharged separately. Units of this type are commonly used in small commercial rice mills.
features: Large feed hopper with flow gate
Milling chamber with adjustable outlet pressure
typicalUses: Whitening and polishing rice in small and medium rice mills.

name: Electric Feed Pelletizing Machine
summary: A flat-die pellet mill that compresses mixed feed meal into firm pellets for poultry, fish, pigs and rabbits.
description: A flat-die pellet mill that compresses mixed feed meal into firm pellets for poultry, fish, pigs and rabbits. Conditioned feed is fed through the stainless-steel hopper, pressed through the die by rollers and cut to length as it exits. Pelleted feed reduces waste and improves feed conversion.
features: Flat die with interchangeable hole sizes
Electric motor with belt or gear drive
typicalUses: On-farm poultry, fish and livestock feed production; also biomass pellets with suitable dies.

name: Electric Maize Thresher
summary: A motorised maize sheller that strips the kernels from dried cobs quickly and cleanly.
description: A motorised maize sheller that strips the kernels from dried cobs quickly and cleanly. Cobs are fed into the hopper, a spiked drum strips the grain, a fan blows off chaff and the grain passes through a screen to the outlet, while the bare cobs are ejected from the end. A wheeled frame and handles make it easy to move between farms.
features: Spiked threshing drum and grain screen

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Typically 2.2–3 kW electric motor or 6.5 hp engine

typicalUses: Shelling dried maize on farms and at aggregation centres.

name: Precision Seed Planter
summary: A hand-pushed precision planter that opens the soil, drops seed at a set spacing and covers it in one pass.
description: A hand-pushed precision planter that opens the soil, drops seed at a set spacing and covers it in one pass. Interchangeable seed plates let it plant maize, groundnut, beans, soybean and similar seeds at consistent depth and spacing.
features: Spiked drive wheel with seed-metering mechanism
Interchangeable seed plates for different crops
typicalUses: Smallholder planting with better germination and less seed waste than hand planting.

name: Groundnut Huller (Peeler)
summary: A machine for removing the red skin (testa) from groundnut kernels, usually after roasting, to produce clean white nuts for paste, snacks and confectionery.
description: A machine for removing the red skin (testa) from groundnut kernels, usually after roasting, to produce clean white nuts for paste, snacks and confectionery. Rubber rollers or brushes rub off the skins while a fan carries them away.
typicalUses: Peanut paste, snack and confectionery production.

name: Corn Mill
summary: A grain mill for grinding maize into flour or meal (and also for millet, sorghum and rice).
description: A grain mill for grinding maize into flour or meal (and also for millet, sorghum and rice). This type has a feed hopper over a steel-toothed grinding chamber and a cyclone and blower that collect the flour, and is driven by an electric motor or diesel engine.
features: Electric motor or diesel engine drive
typicalUses: Community corn-milling services, maize flour and feed production.

name: Disc Mill
summary: A disc (plate) mill grinds grain between a rotating and a fixed toothed disc.
description: A disc (plate) mill grinds grain between a rotating and a fixed toothed disc. It produces fine flour from dry grain and spices; stainless-steel versions like this are used for food products and include a dust-collecting cabinet.
features: Rotating toothed disc and fixed disc
typicalUses: Flour, spice powder, herbs and dried pepper.

name: Hammer Mill
summary: A hammer mill uses fast-spinning swinging hammers to break grain, stalks and dry materials against a screen.
description: A hammer mill uses fast-spinning swinging hammers to break grain, stalks and dry materials against a screen. It is the standard machine for grinding maize and other ingredients for animal feed. Models often include a cyclone to collect the meal.
features: Swing hammers on a high-speed rotor
Electric motor or engine drive; often wheeled
typicalUses: Poultry, pig and cattle feed preparation; grinding maize, soybean, straw and grass.

name: Pepper Mill
summary: A grinding machine for dried pepper, chilli and spices.
description: A grinding machine for dried pepper, chilli and spices. Industrial versions such as this use a high-speed rotor and screen with a cyclone collector to produce fine, uniform powder with less dust.
typicalUses: Pepper, chilli, ginger, spice powders and seasoning production.

name: Multi-Purpose Grinding Machine
summary: A general-purpose grinder for processing a range of dry and moist foods with interchangeable grinding parts, suited to small food businesses that grind several products.
description: A general-purpose grinder for processing a range of dry and moist foods with interchangeable grinding parts, suited to small food businesses that grind several products.
typicalUses: Grains, legumes, spices and vegetables.

name: Groundnut Paste Machine
summary: A colloid mill that grinds roasted groundnuts into smooth paste (peanut butter).
description: A colloid mill that grinds roasted groundnuts into smooth paste (peanut butter). Material is sheared between a fast rotor and a stator; the gap is adjustable to set texture, and paste can be recirculated through the return pipe for a finer finish.
typicalUses: Groundnut paste, sesame paste (tahini), shea and other nut/seed pastes.

name: Cassava Grater
summary: A grating machine that turns peeled cassava into a fine wet mash for gari, agbelima, akple and starch.
description: A grating machine that turns peeled cassava into a fine wet mash for gari, agbelima, akple and starch. A rotating drum covered with sharp grating teeth shreds the roots as they are fed in.

specs.label: Power
specs.value: Typically 3–7.5 kW motor or 6.5–10 hp engine

typicalUses: Gari, agbelima, kokonte and cassava starch processing.

name: Commercial Fufu Machine
summary: A heavy-duty fufu pounding/blending machine for chop bars, restaurants and caterers.
description: A heavy-duty fufu pounding/blending machine for chop bars, restaurants and caterers. It processes boiled cassava, plantain, cocoyam and yam into smooth fufu quickly and hygienically, replacing manual pounding.
typicalUses: Chop bars, restaurants, hotels, institutional kitchens.

name: 2-in-1 Fufu Machine
summary: A compact countertop machine that both pounds fufu and blends/processes other foods.
description: A compact countertop machine that both pounds fufu and blends/processes other foods. Suited to homes and small food vendors.
features: Interchangeable blades for pounding and blending
typicalUses: Homes and small restaurants – fufu, banku, kenkey dough and blending.

name: SB10 Rice Huller / Mill
summary: The SB-10 is a combined mini rice mill that turns paddy into white rice in one machine.
description: The SB-10 is a combined mini rice mill that turns paddy into white rice in one machine. It cleans the paddy over a vibrating sieve and magnet, hulls it between rubber rollers, separates the husk by air, then whitens the rice in the milling chamber, with separate outlets for husk, bran and white rice.
features: Hulling, husk separation and whitening in one unit
Separate outlets for husk, bran and rice
typicalUses: Village and commercial rice milling.

name: SB10D Rice Mill
summary: The diesel-driven version of the SB-10 combined rice mill, coupled to a single-cylinder diesel engine so it can work where there is no mains power.
description: The diesel-driven version of the SB-10 combined rice mill, coupled to a single-cylinder diesel engine so it can work where there is no mains power. It performs cleaning, hulling, husk separation and whitening in one pass.
features: Diesel engine drive for off-grid sites
Hulling and whitening in one unit
Rubber-roll huller and air husk separation
typicalUses: Rural rice milling without mains electricity.

name: SB30 Rice Huller / Mill
summary: A larger combined mini rice mill in the SB series for higher-throughput milling.
description: A larger combined mini rice mill in the SB series for higher-throughput milling. It integrates paddy cleaning, rubber-roll hulling, husk aspiration and whitening, and can be driven by an electric motor or diesel engine.
typicalUses: Commercial rice milling businesses.

name: SB30 Rice Huller Sieve
summary: A replacement perforated milling screen (sieve) for the SB-30 rice mill whitening chamber.
description: A replacement perforated milling screen (sieve) for the SB-30 rice mill whitening chamber. The screen lets bran pass out while retaining the rice; worn or damaged screens reduce milling quality and should be replaced regularly.
features: Made to fit SB-30 milling chamber
Wear part – keep spares in stock

specs.label: Fits
specs.value: SB-30 rice mill (confirm dimensions for other models)

typicalUses: Maintenance and repair of SB-30 rice mills.

name: Satake Bucket Elevator
summary: A bucket elevator lifts grain and rice between machines in a milling line using buckets fixed to a belt or chain.
description: A bucket elevator lifts grain and rice between machines in a milling line using buckets fixed to a belt or chain. Satake is a major Japanese rice-milling equipment brand.
features: Enclosed casing to reduce dust and spillage
Feed hopper at base, discharge at head
typicalUses: Moving paddy and rice between cleaners, hullers, whiteners and bins.

name: 3-inch Petrol Water Pump (PM&T WP30)
summary: A portable 3-inch (80 mm) petrol-engine water pump in a tubular steel frame, used for irrigation, filling tanks and dewatering.
description: A portable 3-inch (80 mm) petrol-engine water pump in a tubular steel frame, used for irrigation, filling tanks and dewatering. WP30-type pumps use a 6.5–7 hp OHV engine and are self-priming once the casing is filled with water.
typicalUses: Vegetable irrigation, water transfer and dewatering.

name: 4-inch Diesel Water Pump
summary: A portable 4-inch (100 mm) water pump powered by an air-cooled diesel engine, offering higher flow and lower fuel cost than petrol pumps for long irrigation hours.
description: A portable 4-inch (100 mm) water pump powered by an air-cooled diesel engine, offering higher flow and lower fuel cost than petrol pumps for long irrigation hours.
typicalUses: Larger-field irrigation, pond filling and dewatering.

name: 4x4 Water Pump with Diesel Engine
summary: A 4-inch suction × 4-inch delivery pump set coupled to a diesel engine for high-volume irrigation and water transfer.
description: A 4-inch suction × 4-inch delivery pump set coupled to a diesel engine for high-volume irrigation and water transfer.
typicalUses: Irrigation schemes, dams and canals, water transfer.

name: 6x6 Kirloskar Pump Set with 10HP Diesel Engine
summary: A heavy-duty 6-inch × 6-inch centrifugal pump set coupled to a 10 hp Kirloskar (India) diesel engine.
description: A heavy-duty 6-inch × 6-inch centrifugal pump set coupled to a 10 hp Kirloskar (India) diesel engine. Kirloskar engines are known for durability and low fuel consumption, making these sets popular for large-volume, low-head irrigation.
features: Belt or direct coupling on base frame

specs.label: Duty
specs.value: High flow, low-to-medium head – confirm curve

typicalUses: Large-scale irrigation, rice fields, flood dewatering.

name: Pressure Pump
summary: An electric surface pump (peripheral or booster type) that raises water pressure for homes, farms and small buildings, or lifts water from a well or tank to an overhead tank.
description: An electric surface pump (peripheral or booster type) that raises water pressure for homes, farms and small buildings, or lifts water from a well or tank to an overhead tank.
features: Can be fitted with pressure switch and tank
typicalUses: Domestic water supply, drip irrigation, boosting pressure.

name: PVC Lay-Flat Irrigation Hose
summary: A flexible PVC discharge hose reinforced with polyester yarn that lies flat when empty for easy rolling and transport.
description: A flexible PVC discharge hose reinforced with polyester yarn that lies flat when empty for easy rolling and transport. Used to carry water from pumps to fields.
typicalUses: Pump discharge, irrigation, dewatering.

name: Diesel Engine for Agricultural Machinery
summary: Single-cylinder, horizontal, water-cooled diesel engines (S195/ZS1115 type) are the workhorses for driving rice mills, corn mills, pumps and threshers.
description: Single-cylinder, horizontal, water-cooled diesel engines (S195/ZS1115 type) are the workhorses for driving rice mills, corn mills, pumps and threshers. They are simple, economical and easy to repair.
typicalUses: Powering mills, hullers, pumps, threshers and generators.

name: Petrol Engine for Agricultural Machinery
summary: Air-cooled, 4-stroke, single-cylinder petrol engines (168F/170F/188F types, 6.5–15 hp) used to power small pumps, grinders, sprayers and threshers.
description: Air-cooled, 4-stroke, single-cylinder petrol engines (168F/170F/188F types, 6.5–15 hp) used to power small pumps, grinders, sprayers and threshers.
features: Recoil start (electric start on larger units)
typicalUses: Small pumps, mini mills, sprayers, generators.

name: Electric Motors for Agricultural Machinery
summary: Single- and three-phase induction motors used to drive mills, hullers, pumps and feed machines where mains power is available.
description: Single- and three-phase induction motors used to drive mills, hullers, pumps and feed machines where mains power is available. Motors are cheaper to run and maintain than engines.
typicalUses: Driving any belt-driven agro-processing machine.

name: Car Washing Machine
summary: A high-pressure washer for cleaning vehicles, tractors, farm machinery and buildings.
description: A high-pressure washer for cleaning vehicles, tractors, farm machinery and buildings. Engine-driven versions work without mains power.
typicalUses: Car washing bays, cleaning tractors and equipment, farm hygiene.
